chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, from Abū Jamīlah and Muḥammad, his brother, from his father, from Abū Jamīlah, from ʿUmar ibn Ḥanẓalah, from al-Shaykh عليه السلام, who said:
If a woman becomes pure before the rising of dawn, she performs the maghrib and the ʿishaʾ prayers; and if she becomes pure before the sun sets, she performs the zuhr and the ʿasr prayers.

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman referred to in the ruling
key_terms.طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ: the rising of dawn, marking the end of the night prayer period

ai.seo_question: What prayers must a woman perform if she becomes pure before dawn or before sunset?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who becomes pure from menstruation or a similar state before the end of a prayer period. It states that if purity occurs before dawn, she must perform maghrib and ʿishaʾ, and if it occurs before sunset, she must perform zuhr and ʿasr.
